finding: The current repository candidate cannot validly close the G2 PipeWire cancel/monitor-readback claim if executed unchanged. It can prove generation-fence rejection and that some null-sink monitor bytes exist, but its pulse-null PASS predicate does not exercise or require the core buffered-playback cancellation/readback invariants requested by the G2 handoff.

defects.evidence: run() writes PRE to the sink, then advances GenerationFence and calls sink.cancel(), and only afterwards calls fence.admit(old_queued). The OLD_SENTINEL is therefore rejected before any sink write in the intended passing path.
defects.consequence: A PASS cannot prove that already-admitted or already-buffered old-generation audio is removed/quiesced by the playback cancellation mechanism. It proves only stale-generation rejection upstream of the sink.
defects.required_repair: Before cancel, admit and queue a deterministic old-generation tail/sentinel far enough ahead to create measurable sink/graph buffering; then cancel at a declared cutover and use monitor readback to quantify any old-generation residual beyond the explicitly predeclared in-flight bound. Separately attempt one late old-generation chunk after generation advance and require upstream rejection.

defects.evidence: pulse_pass requires not late_old_accepted, fence.rejected == 1, len(readback) > 0 and OLD_SENTINEL absent, but does not require NEW_SENTINEL to be observed.
defects.consequence: A capture containing only PRE bytes can satisfy pulse_pass even if the new generation never reaches the monitor. This violates the handoff P6 requirement that the new output generation plays through the same software sink/monitor with clean identity.
defects.required_repair: Require an exact generation-specific new sentinel or robustly detected deterministic new-generation waveform segment in monitor readback after cutover; fail closed if absent.

defects.evidence: The result records cancel call duration and whole-capture hash/counts but no monitor cutover sample index, no last-old-sample index, no preaccepted-buffer frames, no residual duration and no declared admissible in-flight tail.
defects.consequence: The claim requires proving old-packet audio absent after an explicitly measured bounded in-flight tail; current output cannot establish that scope.
defects.required_repair: Bind one monotonic cancel timestamp to monitor sample-domain indices, report preaccepted_buffer_samples_or_frames, last_old_generation_sample_index, residual_old_generation_samples_after_cutover and residual_duration_ms, with an acceptance threshold declared before execution.

defects.evidence: The probe generates constant synthetic PRE/OLD_SENTINEL/NEW_SENTINEL PCM inside Python. It does not consume the exact accepted real Piper/Kokoro-Piper waveform or bind its model/runtime hash to VoiceOutputPacket identity.
defects.consequence: A pulse-null PASS may earn a bounded transport-only probe scope, but not the current G2 P2 integration claim real local Piper PCM -> existing packet/output generation -> sink/monitor.
defects.required_repair: Support an input PCM/WAV path produced by the exact accepted local TTS runtime, bind input hash/sample format/model/runtime receipt and packet/output-generation identity. Test sentinels may be appended/embedded only with explicit lineage and must not replace real-TTS composition evidence.

defects.evidence: Current result lacks PipeWire/pipewire-pulse version and daemon identity, concrete sink/monitor node identity, exact F2 subject SHA, exact packet_id field in returned receipt, and external inference API-call observation count required by the handoff.
defects.consequence: Even a real S2 run would be under-bound for promotion-bearing evidence.
defects.required_repair: Emit exact F2/source/tool blob identity, sandbox/session/daemon identity, sink and monitor node names/ids, packet_id/output_generation, Piper artifact hashes and explicit external inference API calls observed.

defects.evidence: The current tests execute software loopback and generation-fence behavior; the pulse test only searches source text for module-null-sink and zero-credit strings.
defects.consequence: Repository greenness cannot falsify pulse-null lifecycle/capture/cancel logic before VPS runtime.
defects.required_repair: Add a hermetic mocked lifecycle regression for pulse command/result/error handling plus target-runtime pulse-null execution. Do not convert mocked pulse behavior into runtime credit.

primary_source_support.relevant_fact: pw_stream_set_active() activates/deactivates a stream; pw_stream_flush(stream, false) is documented as useful after PAUSED to flush remaining queue/converter data without draining.
module-null-sink is an admitted software sink primitive with configurable name/rate/channels.

primary_source_support.source: WirePlumber monitor ports and pw-cat testing
primary_source_support.relevant_fact: pw-record/pw-play can target concrete node ids; monitor ports expose audio sent to sink nodes, supporting exact node-bound readback.

minimal_repair_acceptance: old-generation sentinel/tail is actually sink-admitted before cancel and measurable as buffered/monitor-visible
late old-generation chunk after generation advance is independently rejected upstream
cancel cutover and monitor sample-domain boundary are bound
post-cutover old-generation residual is measured against a predeclared bounded tail
new-generation sentinel/real waveform is positively observed after cutover
exact real accepted TTS waveform and packet/output-generation identities are bound for P2 composition credit
sink/monitor/PipeWire/runtime/F2 identities and external API-call count are in the receipt
next_exact_action: Trigger 4 should repair only this candidate-falsifier evidence path under the existing G2 semantic owner, add regressions for D1/D2/D3, then execute exactly one S2 PipeWire virtual-sink/monitor run.
